tweets.text:
As you can probably tell from the gist of this memo, I am bearish on AI as a whole, but it’s not an article without an idea.

In 2021, I wrote a piece detailing why ARKK was one of the best shorts I’ve seen. In essence, the attractiveness of shorting ARKK via options is that:

1 No risk of a short squeeze.
2 You are betting against the fund manager, Cathie Wood, in this case.
3 There’s going to be a spiraling effect on the downside. Bad performance begets redemptions, which beget bad performance. The death spiral is nasty.

From a short standpoint, the asymmetry is there, and I’ve followed Cathie’s tendencies well over the past 6 years; she has the habit of doubling down on losing positions, which further contributes to underperformance.

I suspect we are near another short entry point. I have been scouring, and I will likely put on a trade soon, which I’ll publish via a trade alert (rest assured).

I have no appetite to short outright or bet against some of the index heavyweights like Nvidia. I actually really like Jensen.

So for me, shorting something like ARKK makes a lot of sense, especially given the oil macro backdrop. I think that’s the other leg of the oil trade.

Free subscribers can use the 1-time unlock feature to read it.
